item.body:
### Summary

As a reader who prefers it, I want pages to follow each other while I scroll, so that reading is continuous.

### Scope

Option off by default; prefetch without session, reload with session when a page becomes current (two requests per page, FEATURES 🔴 flag semantics), at most 10 pages in memory, haptic per page.

- Module: App · Difficulty: difficult · Priority: low · post-MVP
- Implements: FEAT-017 (#161)
- Absorbs: FEAT-017
- Legacy sources (read-only, `origin/master`): none (new); ultra-hfr ≤ 10 pages in memory (idea only)
- Spec: `docs/features/FEAT-017.md` (feature spec, ADR 0011 §2; write it first if absent, crediting Bybifok) plus a short `docs/lots/LOT-148-*.md` pointing to it

### Depends on

- LOT-083 (#101, done)
- LOT-045 (#71, done)
- LOT-106 (#197, done)

### On hold

Held by the M5_OPEN decision: M5 opens after the M4 parity is validated, and the orchestrator opens it (operator decisions of 2026-11-02 on #379). ([decision](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/379#issuecomment-6573879240))

### Feature umbrella

- Implements FEAT-017 (#161), proposed by Bybifok (credit in the spec, PR and CREDITS.md). Other lots of this feature: none; **this lot is the last one: its PR also says `Closes #161`**.

FEAT issues (#145–#165) are umbrellas and are never claimed: claim this lot's issue; the PR says `Closes #<this issue>` and `Refs #<FEAT issue>`.

### Model

Opus → Fable (AGENTS.md §6: the reviewer is never the author model)

### Captures needed

- none known; any page state the spec needs and the fixtures lack is listed as *pending capture*, never hand-built (LESSONS 35-36)

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Flags never advance beyond the page actually shown (test with request log).
- [ ] View logic lives in `@Observable @MainActor` models tested with Swift Testing in `App/SwiftHFRTests/`; each new test is shown to fail without the change.
- [ ] `xcodebuild build test` green on the iPhone 18 Pro and an iPad simulator (iOS 27.0), and the `App build + tests` CI job green.
- [ ] UI strings in French; light, dark and Dynamic Type XL checked; no new dependency; no HFR fact without a source (legacy file:line or fixture).

### Before you start (agents and humans)

Read, in order: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/agents/ORCHESTRATION.md, docs/agents/REVIEW-ROUNDS.md, docs/agents/LESSONS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, App/README.md, ADR 0012, the spec of every dependency (docs/lots/), docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md for any forum fact, docs/FIXTURES.md if captures are involved. Claim with `/claim <session-id>` on this issue before writing code; PR body `Closes #<this issue>` + `Claim: <session-id>`; never guess HFR behaviour (stop and list the captures needed).

comments.body:
### Operator requirements (2026-11-03), from Bybifok's legacy UI feedback

Feedback: "we read topics of several hundred pages with no simple way to move through the pagination, and no infinite scroll between the pages of a topic, « car passer à la page suivante ça fait le charme de HFR »".

**Requirements:**
- Continuous scrolling is an **option** that each user turns on or off. It is never forced on everyone (FEAT-017 already says it is off by default).
- While scrolling, the **page boundaries stay visible**.
- **Milestone M5** (an evolution, not legacy parity). It is tied to LOT-110 #201 (page navigator, M5 per UXD-10), which covers the easy way to move through the pagination.

**Open questions, kept for M5 (deliberately not answered now):**
1. How many following pages are preloaded below the current one? The idea on the table is to keep loading the 2 pages after the current one.
2. How many pages are kept in memory above the current one?
3. How loading works when a quote links to a reply on a page far back in the topic: jump, hole in the list, then going back.
4. How this works with flag semantics: a GET with the session moves the flag, so prefetch without the session and reload with it (HFR-PROTOCOL §7 E25, FEAT-017).
